blurb: Nonprofits and open source foundations stewarding models, standards, and shared infrastructure, with governance model and funding.

reading.body:
The four organizations listed here represent structurally distinct actors in the AI ecosystem: a nonprofit education platform, a nonprofit evaluation infrastructure body, and two open-source foundations for creative software tools.

The presence of LMSYS alongside Khan Academy, the Krita Foundation, and the Blender Foundation signals that nonprofit governance now reaches into AI evaluation infrastructure, not only into education or creative tooling. LMSYS stewards Chatbot Arena, a shared benchmarking resource, which places model comparison and ranking outside purely commercial control. The other three organizations are relevant to AI primarily as consumers and integrators of AI capabilities rather than as developers of models or training infrastructure.

This dataset covers only four entries and makes no claim to completeness. It records organizational type and a verification date but carries no information on funding sources, compute access, or the scale of operations, so no conclusions about resource constraints or grid dependencies can be drawn from it. What the data does establish is that nonprofit and open-source structures are present across multiple layers of the AI ecosystem, from end-user education to evaluation methodology to the creative applications that AI-generated media increasingly intersects with.
